items.exampleEn: The singer fell during the show but kept her poise.
items.exampleZh: 那位歌手在演出時跌倒了，卻依然保持沉著。

items.exampleEn: A vicious rumor spread about the new teacher.
items.exampleZh: 一則關於新老師的惡毒謠言傳開了。

items.exampleEn: I resent being treated like a child.
items.exampleZh: 我很討厭被當成小孩子看待。

items.exampleEn: The audience burst into spontaneous applause.
items.exampleZh: 觀眾自發地爆出熱烈的掌聲。

items.exampleEn: The climate here is benign, with mild winters.
items.exampleZh: 這裡的氣候溫和，冬天也不冷。

items.exampleEn: "Busy as a bee" is an apt description of my mother.
items.exampleZh: 「像蜜蜂一樣忙」是我媽媽的貼切寫照。

items.exampleEn: The children reluctantly turned off the TV and went to bed.
items.exampleZh: 孩子們不情不願地關掉電視，上床睡覺。

items.exampleEn: The museum's provocative poster got a lot of attention.
items.exampleZh: 博物館那張挑釁意味濃厚的海報吸引了很多注意。

items.sentenceEn: He reluctantly agreed to work on Saturday.
items.sentenceZh: 他不情願地答應了星期六上班。

items.audioEn: Our weekend trip was completely spontaneous; we decided to go at breakfast.
items.audioZh: 我們的週末旅行完全是臨時起意，吃早餐時才決定要去。
items.questionZh: 這趟週末旅行是怎麼決定的？

items.sentenceEn: She handled the difficult questions with great poise.
items.sentenceZh: 她非常沉著地應對那些困難的問題。

items.sentenceEn: Some workers resent having to answer emails at night.
items.sentenceZh: 有些員工很不滿晚上還得回電子郵件。

items.stemEn: The film is meant to be ____; it wants viewers to argue about it afterwards.
items.stemZh: 這部電影刻意引人爭議，希望觀眾看完後去爭論。

items.stemEn: That old dog may look ____, but it is really very gentle.
items.stemZh: 那隻老狗也許看起來很兇，但其實非常溫和。

items.passageEn: At our office's annual talent show, Leo was asked to host the evening. He agreed reluctantly, because he dislikes speaking in public. To everyone's surprise, he showed great poise on stage. His jokes were spontaneous and kind, never vicious. When one guest asked a provocative question about the company's long working hours, Leo gave an apt answer that made everyone laugh, including the boss. Some colleagues used to resent Leo for being so quiet, but after that night, they saw a different side of him. His friends say the evening revealed his hidden ingenuity.
items.passageZh: 在我們公司一年一度的才藝表演上，Leo 被請去主持晚會。他不太情願地答應了，因為他不喜歡在大家面前說話。出乎大家意料，他在台上非常沉著。他的笑話都是即興的，而且很善意，從不刻薄。有位來賓問了一個關於公司工時太長的尖銳問題，Leo 給了一個很貼切的回答，逗得大家都笑了，連老闆也是。有些同事以前不滿 Leo 太安靜，但那晚之後，他們看到了他不同的一面。他的朋友說，那個晚上展現了他隱藏的巧思。

questions.questionZh: Leo 為什麼不太情願當主持人？
options: 他不喜歡在大家面前說話

questions.questionZh: 有人問了尖銳的問題時，Leo 怎麼做？
options: 假裝沒有聽到這個問題

items.promptZh: 她臉上帶著和善的微笑。
referenceEn: She had a benign smile on her face.
There was a benign smile on her face.
rubricZh: benign 表示「和善的、溫和的」（例如 a benign smile 等）
「帶著」可寫，例如 had…on her face、There was… 等

items.promptZh: 這段對話完全是即興的，演員事先沒有排練。
referenceEn: The actors had not practiced this conversation beforehand; it was completely spontaneous.
The conversation was totally spontaneous, and the actors had not practiced it before.
rubricZh: 「即興的」用 spontaneous（例如 completely spontaneous 等）
「事先沒有排練」可寫，例如 had not practiced it beforehand、had not practiced it before 等
時態配合內容（例如 was、is 等）；過去式、現在完成式都正確

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：poise 例句 The dancer's poise and balance 指舞者的優雅儀態／身體姿態，釋義「沉著；泰然自若」對不上例句用法（沉著義在 q11 shadowing 才出現），宜改例句或釋義加「儀態」
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: poise 釋義改為「沉著；優雅的儀態」，對上例句「舞者的儀態與平衡」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：complementary、uncharacteristic 為跨課重複出現的干擾項
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: complementary、uncharacteristic 換成 complimentary（u10-l01）、apt（本課）；q14 的 apt、poise 換成 spontaneous、naive（形容詞，放得進 may look ____ 但語意不通），兩題不共用干擾項

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：自查（App 單字卡只顯示釋義第一義）：benign 釋義第一義「和善的」不是例句示範的詞義
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 釋義改為「溫和、無害的；和善的」，雙義配對的干擾項同步對調

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：自查（執行長釋義原則）：poise 例句「The dancer's poise and balance amazed the audience.」示範的是次要義，第一義應為最常用義「沉著」
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 例句改寫為「The singer fell during the show but kept her poise.」示範第一義；釋義為「沉著；優雅的儀態」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長 c1b2 裁示修正：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長 c1b2 裁示（第 1 批一併改）統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：benign 表示「和善的、溫和的」（例如 a benign smile 等）／「帶著」可寫，例如 had…on her face、There was… 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長 c1b2 裁示修正：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長 c1b2 裁示（第 1 批一併改）統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：spontaneous 表示「臨時起意的、自發的」（例如 a spontaneous decision、a spontaneous trip 等）／時態配合內容（例如 made、took 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 創辦人裁示：造句改翻譯：造句題（spontaneous）原位換成翻譯題，沿用題 id c1-u10-l02-q17；目標字沿用 spontaneous
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 translate：promptZh「這段對話完全是即興的，演員事先沒有排練。」、hintWords ["spontaneous"]、referenceEn ["The actors had not practiced this conversation beforehand; it was completely spontaneous.","The conversation was totally spontaneous, and the actors had not practiced it before."]、rubricZh ["「即興的」用 spontaneous（例如 completely spontaneous 等）","「事先沒有排練」可寫，例如 had not practiced it beforehand、had not practiced it before 等","時態配合內容（例如 was、is 等）；過去式、現在完成式都正確"]（原 makeSentence：instructionZh「用 spontaneous 造一個句子，說說你做過的一件臨時起意的事。」、referenceEn ["Last summer, I made a spontaneous decision to visit Hualien.","My friends and I took a spontaneous trip to the beach last weekend."]）
